description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's merge-recursive functionality, specifically testing rename detection, thresholds, and related options within a version control context.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Generates expected staging information for files involved in the rename detection test.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Checks if the rename was detected as expected.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Checks if the rename was not detected as expected.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Checks the total number of staged files against expected count.

methods.name: check_exact_renames
methods.description: Checks that only exact renames are detected.

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Checks that no renames are detected.
